summary: The shared QUBO is re-expressed as a Classiq QAOA model through canonical_problem.json. The Pulser analog adiabatic program itself is not converted: it has no exact gate equivalent.

mappings.target: QUBO pair coefficients b_ij in the phase cost
mappings.evidence: all 16 assignments agree with canonical energy (classiq/test_example.py)

mappings.source_semantic: final detuning delta as uniform linear term

mappings.target: none (QAOA with 2 layers is a different algorithm)
mappings.evidence: no gate-model equivalent claimed; success probabilities are not comparable
bit order q0..q3 preserved; decoding uses canonical energy
target noise must be configured separately and labelled

losses: analog schedule semantics and its noise behaviour
hardware-specific blockade physics (only its QUBO image is kept)
